content.text: I found extra restrictions on meeting duration, weekends, event buffers, and Friday end times. I’ll remove those, enforce the Friday start cutoff, add console output, and support string durations and start-only events. Since start-only events have no specified length, I’ll treat them as lasting the requested meeting duration.
